sources.title: ABN Amro to cut 5,200 full-time jobs by 2028
sources.description: ABN Amro will cut 5,200 full-time jobs by 2028, the bank announced on Tuesday with its new financial strategy. The bank hopes to achieve about half of the job cuts through attrition, but the rest will be layoffs. ABN Amro did not say which departments will be affected.

sources.title: ABN Amro to axe 5,200 jobs by 2028 to reduce costs
sources.description: ABN Amro plans to cut 5,200 positions by 2028 as part of a broader strategy to reduce costs and focus on its core business activities.
